description: Hook condivisi del workspace frontaliere, equivalenti a .claude/settings.json.

hooks.command: sh -c 'find_policy() { d="$1"; [ -n "$d" ] || return 1; d="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$d" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || return 1; while :; do [ -f "$d/bin/github-api-policy.mjs" ] && { printf "%s/bin/github-api-policy.mjs\n" "$d"; return 0; }; parent="$(dirname "$d")"; [ "$parent" = "$d" ] && return 1; d="$parent"; done; }; p="$(find_policy "$PWD" || find_policy "${WORKSPACE:-}" || find_policy "${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-}" || find_policy "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}")" || exit 0; node "$p"'
hooks.statusMessage: Instradamento obbligatorio delle chiamate GitHub nel coordinatore
Risoluzione obbligatoria della blocklist PII nei linked worktree
